allFindings.description: Base container image tag 'python:3.11-slim' is not pinned to an immutable digest (SHA256).
allFindings.rationale: Using mutable tags like python:3.11-slim could introduce upstream supply chain drift or breaking changes between builds. Pinning to a specific image digest (e.g., python:3.11-slim@sha256:...) ensures deterministic and tamper-evident container builds.
